_comment: Cosmic Starlight collection: each line is a celestial body. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed cosmic-starlight`, then given a look each (two lines per look; Victini the sun, Milotic's line an aurora, Frillish's a nebula...). Shared look in styles/_cosmic.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Cosmic Starlight
readme.summary: Pokemon as celestial bodies: nebulae, galaxies, suns, moons, comets, black holes, ringed planets, auroras and eclipses.
looks: each line is one celestial body: nebula (Bulbasaur, Frillish), galaxy (Ekans, Spoink), sun (Victini, Archen), moon (Karrablast, Fomantis), comet (Electrike, Buizel), black hole (Stunky, Genesect), ringed planet (Spritzee, Bruxish), aurora (Feebas, Pansage), eclipse (Pawniard, Falinks)
stars scattered over the dark parts that twinkle in the dark; coronas, accretion rings, comet tails, auroras and planet rings glow
shiny: the colours turned round the colour wheel (a blue sun, a green nebula...); the moon turns into a blood moon
